The latest info. I got will be a Sep 18th or 19th release date.  This
of course is tentative.  The first release will be very limited due to
the fact that they are having problems with the printing equipment.  The
numbers I've heard is around 5% - 10% initial shipment, with maybe 3 seperate
shipments.
Note: don't forget everything has to go through US Customs.

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
The first Jyhad shipments should be in distributors' warehouses in
time for GenCon, and the very first cards on sale then.  So presumably
they will be at at least some retailers before end of August.  But yes,
there have been problems with the machines, so the shipments are going
to be delayed some...  record heat in Belgium, I think.
